findings.title: Q13 parent failure predicates can pass solely because ACK is missing
findings.reason: worker_main_fixture creates parent InvocationState without acknowledge(parent). In delayed/failed publication modes, parent.decision(CLEAR,True)==124 can therefore pass when request_stop fails to retain the publication-gap cause: decision rejects missing ACK with124. The separate unpublished-latch state in q13 has the same missing-ACK fallback. This makes the claimed acceptance-disqualification predicate vacuous for that invariant.
findings.correction: Establish a valid acknowledged parent baseline before injecting publication failure, including the separate unpublished-latch state. After injection assert the original identity-observation stage, publication-gap detail and124 remain; then assert failed decision. Do not infer actual site acceptance from this synthetic ACK.

findings.title: Q06 does not exercise the corrected failure-lock release during query spawn
findings.reason: Holding state.lock around soft_stop proves timer wake independence, and manually registering a child after completed escalation proves stop_new_child routing. Neither calls actual InvocationState.query with its launch callback blocked inside a Popen-like spawn while another request_stop must acquire failure_lock. Restoring the original OBS01 failure-lock-across-spawn defect would not be detected by these variants.
findings.correction: Add one bounded Q06 variant using the actual query launch callback with an injected blocked spawn. Concurrently invoke actual request_stop and require retained pending cause plus signal wake before releasing spawn. Release/join in finally; register returned fake handle and exercise stop_new_child cleanup. Keep barriers2s, no native process or separate model.

findings.title: Q11 lacks parent-first then later worker-receipt precedence predicate
findings.reason: The existing import_failure variant imports a worker receipt into a fresh state then requests generic guard failure. The earlier regression unconditionally replaced an already latched parent failure with a later worker receipt; that defective version still satisfies this worker-first test. Parent-vs-guard tests do not call import_failure.
findings.correction: Add a small variant: latch a structured parent observation failure, import a different later valid worker receipt, assert parent first-failure identity/code/detail remain and conflict history records both. Retain existing worker-first variant. No further native fixture is needed.
